title: Can an Instrument Notice Where the Work Stops?
idiom: muted Hammershøi-quiet gouache, a piano that remembers where the playing stopped
hero_prompt: Quiet gouache painting in the manner of a Hammershøi interior, muted greys and one warm light, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible brush and paper texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: an empty room at evening with a single upright piano, its lid open and the stool pushed back as if the player has just stood up and left; on top of the piano a small hourglass with its sand half run through, a small lamp casting a warm circle, and one single key of the keyboard glowing softly where the playing stopped. Bare walls, nothing hung on them.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm grey ground, no shading or gradients: an upright piano seen from the front with a small hourglass standing on top of it. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
